images.title: How cookieless tools count visitors
images.alt: Flow showing how Plausible and Fathom count visitors: IP address and user agent plus a daily secret become a scrambled identifier.

items.label: IP address + user agent
items.text: Taken from the visit, with no cookie set

items.label: Add a daily secret
items.text: A secret value that changes every day

items.label: Scrambled identifier
items.text: Used to count unique visitors; the raw IP isn't stored

items.label: Next day, new secret
items.text: Plausible deletes the daily value after 24 hours
